rv.q: The revival by Hive North acknowledges the progress made in the intervening years as a result of the work of, and pressure from, activists and so provides hope in these increasingly dark times whilst also featuring an outstanding performance from Gabriel Clark.
In a remarkably mature stage debut ... John Bell completely inhabits the role of the protagonist. It’s a credit to Drake’s writing that none of his dialogue has lost its edge over the past 20 years.
